verdict.rationale: Marqeta's authorization controls explicitly let ops limit transactions to a single merchant or group of merchants (implying allowlist/blocklist by MCC or merchant), enforced at authorization time as part of Core API's authorization controls and velocity controls. This is corroborated by both docs and the MCC/merchant restriction feature listed in the MCP server spend-controls description. Missing for 10: explicit documentation distinguishing MCC allowlist vs blocklist syntax and independent/hands-on verification of authorization-time enforcement behavior.
